mapper.select: SELECT id,active_name AS activeName,active_time AS activeTime,duration, active_area AS activeArea,active_style AS activeStyle,create_name AS createName,active_number AS activeNumber,createtime AS createTime FROM activities WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE activities SET active_name = #{activeName}, active_area = #{activeArea}, active_time = #{activeTime}, duration = #{duration}, active_style = #{activeStyle}, updateId = #{updateId}, updatetime = current_time WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE activities SET del_flag = '1', updateId = #{updateId}, updatetime = current_time WHERE id = #{id}

UPDATE activities SET
active_number = active_number + 1
active_number = active_number - 1
WHERE id = #{id}
